reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getCategoriesForAverage (built on shouldFillCategory) and the sign from averageToBudgetAmount, and reuses getSheetValue, setBudget and batchMessages.

duplication.why: No selection or sign logic is copied; the action body only adds the previous-month sheet lookup.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts with its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Only the new action and its registration are added.

maintainability.why: Small and consistent; it leans on helpers named for averages (getCategoriesForAverage, averageToBudgetAmount), which slightly obscures intent, and it adds no tests.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category eligibility goes through getCategoriesForAverage/shouldFillCategory like the average actions.

disguised_duplication.where: None; setLastMonthSpending delegates selection and sign to existing helpers.
